import sys


def main():
    path = "./data/notes.txt"
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        data = f.read()

    lines = data.splitlines()
    line_count = len(lines)

    todo_count = 0
    seen = set()
    distinct = []
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith("TODO:"):
            todo_count += 1
            text = line[len("TODO:"):].strip()
            if text not in seen:
                seen.add(text)
                distinct.append(text)

    out = sys.stdout
    out.write("notes: %d lines, %d todos\n" % (line_count, todo_count))
    for text in distinct:
        out.write(text + "\n")
    if todo_count >= 1:
        out.write("todo file not written\n")
    out.flush()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
